patterns: Mostly direct one-liners: 'Magna Carta of English education' = Wood's Despatch; 'most important document' (APPSC) = Charles Wood's Despatch.
Year/viceroy pairings and chronology (Wood 1854, Hunter 1882, Sadler 1917, Sargent 1944; first universities 1857) and match-the-year lists.

Institution-founder pairs: Fort William = Wellesley (purpose: training civilians), Sanskrit College Varanasi = Jonathan Duncan, Hindu College = Ram Mohan Roy/David Hare; APPSC 'odd one' tests missionary colleges incl. Noble College.
Hunter Commission = primary education; Sadler = Calcutta University; Curzon's 1902 commission Indian members Bilgrami + Gurudas Banerjee.
App goes much deeper into Andhra-specific minutiae (Narsapur branches, Rajahmundry chronology, grants-in-aid year) and multi-statement formats than the PYQs show.
